hints.title: Track the First Element
hints.text: Notice that the remaining numbers always form an arithmetic progression. You only need to track the first element, step size, and remaining count.

hints.title: Directional Elimination Rule
hints.text: When eliminating left-to-right, the head always moves forward by step. When eliminating right-to-left, the head only moves if the number of remaining elements is odd.

hints.title: Update Step and Count
hints.text: In each round, double the step size, divide remaining count by 2, and flip the traversal direction.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def lastRemaining(self, n: int) -> int:
        head = 1
        step = 1
        remaining = n
        left_to_right = True
        
        while remaining > 1:
            if left_to_right or remaining % 2 == 1:
                head += step
            remaining //= 2
            step *= 2
            left_to_right = not left_to_right
        
        return head
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Creating and shrinking an explicit list takes O(n) memory and O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(1) memory by maintaining progression invariants.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects arithmetic progression invariant maintenance in O(log n) time and O(1) space.
